text:
emily: Quick sync — partner webinar next Wed 9am PT. Speakers: @kelsey (Redwood), @sanju (NovaCloud), @jordan (TensorEdge). Need final slide deck, demo fallback, and kit manifest for shipping. Who owns what?

kelsey: I can own the deck + 10min talk outline. Will ping @sanju after lunch. Need to confirm demo creds for the live lab. :raised_hands:

ajay: I’ll take demo fallback/runbook. Drop model versions and example prompts here and I’ll build the short-circuit path.

emily: model list suggestion: `redwood-lite-v1`, `redwood-quant-v2`, `open-llama-7b-ql`. Can we standardize prompts to 3 examples per demo?

ajay: perfect. will format as: ```
- prompt_a: classification
- prompt_b: summarize
- prompt_c: interactive
```

samir: Shipping ops: stickers + shirts schedule — pickup Mon 08:00 from Warehouse B. Courier ETA to venue Tue 14:00. I need the kit manifest (weight, dims, qty). Who has the final counts?

maggie: Marketing confirmed quantities: 150 stickers, 60 shirts (mix S-XL), 50 postcards, 100 QR cards. Budget ok. We can add a small partner postcard with a promo code.

emily: great. @samir i’ll DM you the address for pickup. Also need a plan B if onsite network blocks the demo. Ajay, can you list fallback endpoints (private + hosted)?

ajay: plan B endpoints: `redwood-hosted/api/v1/generator` (hosted), `dedicated-01.redwood.internal` (dedicated). Will include health checks and a short failover script: `curl -sS $ENDPOINT/health || switch-to fallback`.

kelsey: rehearsal: can we do a dry run Tue 11am PT with all speakers on the call? 20 min walk-through + 10 min Q&A.

emily: yes — block calendar. @devex-bot can you post the checklist to #partnerships and attach the deck link? https://drive.redwood.example/partner-webinar/guest-kit-v3

devex-bot: Checklist posted in #partnerships: "Guest webinar checklist v3" with deck link and runbook. :white_check_mark:

samir: Added shipping tracking: courier AWB 1Z9999 -> I’ll update if ETA changes.

emily: Perfect. Next steps: Kelsey finalizes deck by EOD tomorrow, Ajay posts runbook + failover script, Samir confirms pickup time by Fri. Thanks all. :pray:
